notes: Text archives use .txt to avoid imports/test discovery. A missing final LF is normalized; six mixed-CRLF files retain original CRLF line indices. Original SHA and size are verified by reconstructing those bytes.
Runtime versions are capture-time observations, not proof of versions used for historical tests.
Operational data was hashed read-only, not atomically snapshotted; do not call this a consistent DB backup.
No secrets, raw market data or human trading ledger copied. No strategy/backtest rerun.
